name: XTaxes
caption: Əlavə modullar / Ödənişlər və köçürmələr / Vergi ödənişləri

datasets.name: ods_in
datasets.sql:
select c.id as cust_id,a.id as acc_id,c.name as cust_name, a.acc_no,a.name acc_name,t.fleg,t.sys_date,t.sys_datetim,t.block_text,t.ammount,
case when t.fleg='D'then a.limit
    when t.fleg='A'then t.ammount end limit,
case  when t.fleg ='A' then 'Vergi Alinmali'
      when t.fleg ='D' then 'Vergi Dondurulmali'
      when t.fleg ='AI' then 'İşsizlik Alinmali'
      when t.fleg ='DI' then 'İşsizlik Dondurulmali'
      when t.fleg ='AS' then 'Sosiyal Alinmali'
      when t.fleg ='DS' then 'Sosiyal Dondurulmali'
      when t.fleg ='GA' then 'Vergi Alınma Geri çağrlmalı'
      when t.fleg ='GD' then 'Vergi Dondurulma Geri çağrlmalı'
      when t.fleg ='GAI' then 'İşsizlik Alınma Geri çağrlmalı'
      when t.fleg ='GDI' then 'İşsizlik Dondurulma Geri çağrlmalı'
      when t.fleg ='GAS' then 'Sosiyal Alınma Geri çağrlmalı'
      when t.fleg ='GDS' then 'Sosiyal Dondurulma Geri çağrlmalı'
end fleg_txt,
    t.coll_num,t.bank_text,t.limit_tesxt,coll_date
 from  taxs_accept t,account a,customers c where t.accno=a.acc_no and a.kli_id=c.id
and sys_date between :begin_dat and :end_dat







order by c.id asc

datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql: select coll_num,text ,replace(replace(field,'/',null),'-','_') as colum from taxs_fild_temporary

datasets.name: ods_a
datasets.sql:
SELECT
    coll_num,
    inscountid,
    MAX(DECODE(inforid, '0', text)) AS bname,
    MAX(DECODE(inforid, '1', text)) AS code,
    MAX(DECODE(inforid, '2', text)) AS counts,
    MAX(DECODE(inforid, '3', text)) AS amount
   
  FROM
    taxs_report_temporary
GROUP BY inscountid,coll_num
ORDER BY inscountid
